authorization: User explicitly authorized two independent security publishers agreeing on the vulnerability class, with Codex reasoning documented
adjudication_basis: BlockSec attributes the exploit to a missing liquidity check in donateToReserves. PeckShield explicitly says the donation must leave the donor over-collateralized. Their independent mechanism accounts agree on an accounting/solvency check failure, not reentrancy. No SWC/DASP code is forced onto this DeFi-specific invariant failure.

independent_observations.mechanism_excerpt: The root cause is due to the lack of liquidity check in the function donateToReserves()
Specifically, the donateToReserves needs to ensure the donator is still over-collateralized.
